newsitem.title: USA: Culligan gets $51 mln from Anvil redemption.
newsitem.headline: Culligan gets $51 mln from Anvil redemption.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Monday it had received about $51 million in cash proceeds as a result of the redemption by Anvil Holdings Inc of the Anvil securities owned by Culligan.
The redemption of the securities, which Culligan acquired in January 1995 for $9 million, resulted in a pretax gain in excess of $31 million.
Culligan said that it would use the proceeds to repay acquisition related debt and fund added growth.
Culligan makes and distributes water purification and treatment products for retail, household, bottled water, commercial and industrial applications.
